D121.people: A large group of young schoolchildren standing on stage risers in front of a blue backdrop; no family member is individually identifiable at this distance
D121.event: A school concert or end-of-year performance on a gymnasium/auditorium stage
D121.notes: Wide audience-seat shot of a kindergarten-age class performance; a daughter is presumably among the singers but cannot be picked out. Useful only as a school-years establishing frame.

D122.people: The father (shaved head) sitting propped against a tufted headboard reading aloud from a purple folder, with three daughters piled against him — one small girl in his lap, one tucked under each arm
D122.event: Father reading aloud to all three daughters on a bed
D122.theme: Fatherhood; Parenthood; Everyday life; Family of five
D122.notes: All three girls are physically draped over their father while he reads — the whole family-of-five dynamic in one unposed frame. Slightly soft and casually framed, but the closeness is real.

D123.people: The father in a baseball cap, polo and shorts standing on a lawn, with a small daughter in a teal top and black shorts standing at his feet
D123.event: UNKNOWN — father and youngest daughter standing together on a manicured lawn, possibly a park or club grounds
D123.notes: Straightforward full-length snapshot of father and youngest on grass; the size difference between them is the only real content. No visible activity to identify.

D124.people: The father (shirtless, mirrored sunglasses) and the mother (dark hair, blue swimsuit, sunglasses) cheek to cheek in a selfie
D124.event: Beach selfie with surf and swimmers behind them
D124.theme: Vacations; Growing older; Growing together; The life we built
D124.notes: Sun-lit couple selfie at the shore, both genuinely smiling. Handsome but it is one of several near-identical beach selfies in this stretch.

D125.people: An older man with a cane and an older woman (grandparents) seated in a row of green airport gate chairs with three girls between and beside them
D125.event: Waiting at an airport gate with the grandparents before a flight
D125.theme: Vacations; Adventure; Growing older; Everyday life
D125.notes: Three generations wedged into airport seating with snacks and a shopping bag on the floor — the unglamorous front end of a family trip. Cluttered background and flat light.

D126.people: Three girls sitting together on the bow cushion of a powerboat; an adult stands at the helm behind them, partly hidden by the console
D126.event: Boat day — the three sisters riding on the bow while the boat is underway or docked in a canal
D126.notes: The three girls in sun hats and swimsuits are small in the frame against a lot of white fiberglass, but it reads clearly as the start of a boat day.

D127.people: The mother in a wide straw sun hat and sunglasses and the father in an orange cap and sunglasses, selfie on a boat
D127.event: Couple selfie on a boat over turquoise water
D127.theme: Vacations; Growing together; The life we built
D127.notes: Bright, sharp couple selfie with open water behind; both are relaxed and laughing. Strong colour but compositionally a standard arm's-length shot.

D128.people: The mother alone, seated on the gunwale of a boat with her hair blown back, holding a straw hat in her lap and looking out to sea
D128.event: Quiet moment on the boat, looking out at the water
D128.notes: Rare solo portrait of the mother — turned away from the camera toward the horizon, wind in her hair, clean sky and sea behind. Reads as a breath in the middle of the trip.

D129.people: The three daughters sitting shoulder to shoulder on a wooden bench in white and pale dresses, tropical planting behind them
D129.event: Posed portrait of the three sisters on a bench, dressed up for a resort evening
D129.notes: Cooperative posed sisters portrait, all three in white with matching sandals. Pleasant and well lit, but it is the standard 'line the girls up' setup.

D130.people: The father in a pink shirt and white trousers and the mother in a long white dress with a gold kimono, standing together on a resort path
D130.event: Dressed-up couple portrait before a resort dinner
D130.theme: Vacations; Marriage; Growing together; The life we built
D130.notes: Full-length, well-lit portrait of the two of them dressed for an evening out, palms and colonial architecture behind. The strongest 'still a couple' frame in this batch.

D131.people: The father in a pink shirt walking away from camera at dusk carrying the youngest daughter on his hip, holding the middle daughter's hand, with the eldest in a white dress walking ahead
D131.event: Walking back along a marina dock at dusk after dinner, all seen from behind
D131.theme: Fatherhood; Vacations; Parenthood; The life we built
D131.notes: Backs-turned dusk frame of a father hauling one daughter, leading another by the hand and following the third — motion-blurred and dark, but it carries more than any posed shot on the sheet.

D132.people: The mother in a white top standing behind her three daughters in front of tropical greenery at a resort
D132.event: Posed portrait of mother and the three girls outside a resort building
D132.theme: Motherhood; Vacations; Sisterhood; Family of five
D132.notes: Standard vacation lineup of mother with all three daughters against palms and hedges; everyone is smiling at the camera, nothing is happening.

D133.people: The mother and the father (shirtless) cheek to cheek in a beach selfie, both wearing sunglasses
D133.event: Beach selfie during the island trip
D133.theme: Vacations; Growing together; The life we built
D133.notes: Near-duplicate of the earlier beach couple selfie a week or so before — same pose, same framing. Keep one of the pair, not both.

D134.people: The three daughters seated apart from one another on the steps and edge of a large resort pool, all with their backs to the camera
D134.event: Early morning at the resort pool before it fills up
D134.notes: Three small figures spaced across an empty turquoise pool, all facing away — unusually graphic composition compared with the rest of the vacation take.

D135.people: The mother and father standing in shallow pool water with the three daughters in front of them, the youngest in a green life vest
D135.event: All five in the resort pool, pastel Bahamian-style buildings and palms behind
D135.notes: Clean, bright, complete family-of-five frame in the water — good record shot of the trip, but posed and smiling at the lens.

D136.people: The father in sunglasses and the mother in a coral top at one end of a green picnic table, two older girls across the table (one with arms raised), and a small blonde girl at the near right edge
D136.event: Casual meal or snack at an outdoor picnic table at the resort
D136.theme: Vacations; Everyday life; Family of five
D136.notes: Loose candid around a picnic table with one girl throwing her arms up mid-sentence. Identities at the far end of the table are hard to confirm; framing is crooked and cluttered.

D137.people: The mother in a pink top and denim shorts and the father in a black shirt standing side by side on a resort plaza
D137.event: Couple posed in front of the pink Atlantis-style resort towers at golden hour
D137.notes: Standard 'stand in front of the landmark hotel' couple shot; the building gets more of the frame than they do.

D138.people: The three daughters kneeling and lying in a pile on white sand at dusk, in swimsuits, laughing toward the camera
D138.event: The three sisters playing in the sand at last light with the resort and palms behind them
D138.notes: Wide, quiet dusk frame: three sisters tangled together on empty sand under a pastel sky and palm silhouettes. Composition and light both hold up for a long screen hold.

D139.people: The father holding the camera at arm's length with the mother and all three daughters crowded in behind him at the water's edge
D139.event: Sunset family selfie on the beach at the end of the trip
D139.notes: All five faces in one frame with an evening sky behind; the youngest is looking off to the side. Warm but a familiar arm's-length composition.

D140.people: The father, mother and three daughters standing in a row at the water's edge, small in a wide frame of sea and pastel cloud
D140.event: Wide family-of-five portrait standing in the shallows at sunset
D140.theme: Vacations; Family of five; The life we built
D140.notes: The five of them small against a big soft sky and turquoise water — the most cinematic of the several family beach frames from this evening.

D141.people: The three daughters sitting together inside a large red heart-shaped sculpture on a resort lawn
D141.event: The girls posing inside a heart-shaped photo installation at the resort
D141.notes: The girls are tiny inside an oversized red heart prop; a cute gag frame but they are too small to read faces.

D142.people: The mother and father standing behind a table, flanked by the three daughters; the youngest in front wears a shirt reading BIRTHDAY
D142.event: A birthday celebration — sheet cake with sprinkles and a large rose-shaped candle on the table in front of them
D142.theme: Milestones; Family of five; Parenthood; Everyday life
D142.notes: Whole family lined up behind an uncut white birthday cake on a covered patio; the birthday girl's shirt makes the occasion legible without a caption.

D143.people: The mother in a knit beanie reading MAMA, cheek to cheek in a selfie with the youngest daughter in a pale pink pom-pom hat
D143.event: Cold-weather selfie of mother and youngest daughter, both bundled in coats and hats
D143.theme: Motherhood; Parenthood; Everyday life; Growing together
D143.notes: Both faces fill the frame in real winter light, the little girl grinning wide-eyed under a pom hat. The MAMA beanie does a lot of narrative work for free.

D144.people: The mother in a long black winter coat carrying a daughter in a lilac coat and white knit hat, on a porch at night
D144.event: Mother carrying her daughter on a porch during a cold evening outing
D144.notes: Dim, slightly noisy night frame of a mother still hoisting a kid who is getting too big to carry. Technically weak, emotionally straightforward.

D145.people: The father, mother and three daughters posed with a man in a Santa suit in front of a balloon arch and tinsel curtain
D145.event: Family photo with Santa at a holiday party
D145.notes: Annual Santa-photo setup with balloons and a photo backdrop; everyone is in holiday sweaters and Santa hats. Repeats a recurring holiday-portrait pattern in the archive.

D146.people: The mother in a Santa hat and a young daughter in white dragging a cut fir tree toward camera, the father at right holding the saw aloft, and one more person behind them
D146.event: Cutting down a Christmas tree at a tree farm and hauling it out of the rows
D146.notes: Mid-action frame: the tree is down and being dragged, the father is brandishing the saw like a trophy. A fourth figure behind the tree is too obscured to identify.

D147.people: A young girl in a white knit hat and lilac coat grinning open-mouthed at the camera holding a wrapped Christmas gift; two adults stand blurred behind her
D147.event: A daughter outdoors holding a wrapped Christmas present, apparently mid-delivery or exchange
D147.notes: Big unguarded grin filling the frame, gift held out in both hands. The two adults behind are out of focus and not identifiable.

D148.people: The three daughters standing in front of a decorated Christmas tree; two in pajamas and the youngest in a red dress
D148.event: The sisters posed by the Christmas tree in the evening
D148.notes: Standard tree-side sibling portrait; useful as a yearly size-comparison marker but visually repetitive with other holiday frames.

D149.people: An older daughter kneeling at a round coffee table across from a younger sister, playing a game with red plastic cups; Christmas tree and stockings behind
D149.event: Two sisters playing a cup game in the living room on Christmas Eve
D149.notes: Unposed Christmas Eve texture — two sisters absorbed in a game across a coffee table with the decorated room around them. Wide and a bit cluttered, but genuinely candid.

D150.people: Several people sprawled on couches in a dark basement room facing a large projection screen; faces are not readable
D150.event: Watching a football game on the big screen on Christmas Day, lit only by the screen and the tree
D150.notes: Very dark, heavily underexposed room shot; the Christmas tree in the corner and the game on screen tell you it is Christmas afternoon, but nobody is identifiable.

D151.people: The three daughters in winter coats, hats and gloves standing on ice skates against the rink boards
D151.event: The three girls skating at an ice rink during the holiday break
D151.notes: All three on skates and upright, youngest included — a clear marker that the little one is now big enough to join. Posed against the boards mid-session.

D152.people: The father and the youngest daughter side by side, both sticking their tongues out and crossing their eyes for the camera, in a busy shop or ice-cream counter
D152.event: Silly face-pulling selfie with a striped drink cup on the counter beside them
D152.theme: Humor; Fatherhood; Everyday life; Growing together
D152.notes: Father and daughter pulling identical goofy faces, tongues out — the mirroring is the whole point and it lands. Busy background, but the two of them dominate.

D153.people: Two girls playing near the fireplace with a stick, a third child at right, in a wide view of the open-plan living room with a football game on the TV
D153.event: Ordinary afternoon at home — kids messing around indoors with a game on in the background
D153.notes: Wide, room-scale frame that documents the house itself as much as the kids. Faces are small; value is as everyday-texture B-roll.

D154.people: A daughter seated at a nail salon station having her nails painted by a technician; other customers and staff in the background
D154.event: A daughter getting a manicure at a nail salon
D154.notes: A small girl dwarfed by a grown-up salon chair, hand out on the cushion. Reads as one of the first grown-up-ritual outings; the salon interior is well lit but busy.

D155.people: An older daughter seated at a nail salon station with a technician working on her nails under a UV lamp
D155.event: A daughter getting her nails done at the salon the day after her sister's visit
D155.notes: Companion frame to the previous day's salon photo, same room and setup with the other daughter. Keep one of the two unless the pairing is used deliberately.

D156.people: A youth basketball team of about eleven children in white and green jerseys with three adult coaches standing behind them; the father appears to be one of the adults at back
D156.event: End-of-season youth basketball team photo indoors
D156.notes: Formal team lineup in a hall; a daughter is presumably in the row but cannot be identified with confidence, and the father reads as one of the coaches.

D157.people: About ten girls in youth lacrosse uniforms with sticks, moving together on a turf field; coaches and parents on the sideline
D157.event: A girls' youth lacrosse game or practice on a turf field
D157.notes: Action-adjacent field shot of a swarm of small players with sticks; no family member is clearly identifiable in the pack.

D158.people: A young daughter in a pink beanie, purple fleece and gloves standing at the sideline fence holding a lacrosse stick
D158.event: The youngest daughter on the sideline at a cold lacrosse practice or game, holding her own stick
D158.notes: Solo portrait of the smallest player, stick nearly as tall as she is, water bottle on the bench behind. Clean light and a genuinely uncertain expression.

D159.people: The mother in a cap reading MOM of GIRLS, cheek to cheek in a selfie with a beaming daughter wearing a rainbow candy-bead necklace
D159.event: Outdoor selfie of mother and daughter, the girl grinning with a candy necklace on
D159.notes: Enormous open-mouthed grin from the daughter against her mother's cheek, and the cap literally spells out the household. Bright natural light, tight crop.

D160.people: The mother, the father wearing bunny ears and holding the youngest daughter, and the two older daughters (one also in bunny ears) posed outdoors on grass
D160.event: Easter Sunday family portrait in the yard, dressed up and wearing bunny ears
D160.notes: Full family in Easter clothes with the father gamely wearing bunny ears while holding the youngest. Posed, but the adults playing along gives it some warmth.

D161.people: The mother between two daughters, all three cheek to cheek in a close selfie; the younger girl is missing her front teeth
D161.event: Close selfie of mother and two daughters, dressed up indoors in bright window light
D161.notes: Three faces filling the frame, all laughing, gap-toothed grin on the younger girl dating the year precisely. Taken on the same dressed-up day as the church-steps frames.

D162.people: A man in a tan suit and a woman standing with four girls in dresses in a bright tiled hall; one girl wears a formal white dress and veil-less white outfit
D162.event: A formal church-related celebration — the white dress and setting suggest a First Communion, though this is not confirmed by anything visible in the frame
D162.theme: Milestones; Extended family; Holidays; Growing older
D162.notes: Group of relatives lined up against a window wall in a parish hall; the adults here are not the parents. Backlit and squinting, but it anchors the day as a religious milestone.

D163.people: The mother, the father in a tan suit and sunglasses, and the three daughters on the steps of a brick church, the middle-sized girl in a long white dress
D163.event: Family portrait on the church steps after what appears to be a First Communion or similar church milestone for one daughter
D163.theme: Milestones; Family of five; Parenthood; Growing older
D163.notes: All five dressed up on the church steps with one daughter in the white ceremonial dress — the clearest milestone frame of the batch. Posed and squinting into sun, but unambiguous.

D164.people: The father in sunglasses and a tan shirt and the mother in a dark top, cheek to cheek in a selfie outdoors among trees
D164.event: Couple selfie in their dressed-up clothes on the day of the church celebration
D164.notes: The two of them alone for a second in the middle of a family occasion, still in their good clothes. Pleasant but another arm's-length selfie.

D165.people: The mother in a t-shirt with two daughters pressed in on either side, selfie at an outdoor field with other people in the background
D165.event: Selfie at an outdoor sports field or park event, apparently on Mother's Day weekend
D165.notes: Sun-squinting field-side selfie, both girls in team shirts and grinning against their mother. One of three photos from the same day.

D166.people: The mother in sunglasses seated on a bench outdoors with the three daughters lined up beside her in bright spring clothes
D166.event: Posed portrait of mother with all three daughters on a bench, apparently Mother's Day
D166.theme: Motherhood; Family of five; Everyday life
D166.notes: Classic Mother's Day lineup, all four on one bench in green and pink. Clean and cheerful, compositionally conventional.

D167.people: The mother reclining in a patio chair reading a handmade card, with a young daughter in a swimsuit beside her, mouth open mid-shout
D167.event: Mother reading a card from her daughter on the back porch while the girl reacts
D167.notes: Wholly unposed: the mother is actually reading the card while the daughter yells something at her from a foot away. Dim porch light and awkward framing, but the moment is real.

D168.people: The mother and father cheek to cheek in a selfie, both wearing JR. LIONS lacrosse team shirts, at a crowded outdoor field event
D168.event: Couple selfie in team gear at a youth lacrosse event or team party
D168.theme: Sports; Growing together; Everyday life; The life we built
D168.notes: Both parents in matching club lacrosse shirts on the sideline — the sports-parent era rendered as a couple portrait. Bright, sharp, background full of tents and drink coolers.
